Hello fellow '''Wheel of Time''' enthusiasts!

I may have finally gone off the deep end on this one <small>(and may never have the time to see it through)</small> but let's have a toast to beginning new things!

Picture you and me building a new world together... on <font color="*7FFFD4*"><b>MINECRAFT</b></font>.

<BIG><I>Can you picture it yet?</I></BIG>

Here, let me help you.

A world of stackable blocks. It is nearly limitless except by your imagination; and when put into a strong-arm hold and molded into the shape of our desire (The Wheel of Time map, of course) our lives can finally be complete. ''OK... I know, I'm being a little bit dramatic''.

Our friends at <U>[https://wot.fandom.com/ A Wheel of Time Wiki]</U> have already extrapolated several, if not all of the descriptions and verbal paintings of each town, city, and characters' residences.

We will be building from a basic <small>Bedrock</small> <font color="*7FFFD4*"><b>MINECRAFT</b></font> seed from the default terrain up.
 Block by Block = No paint software + No fancy programming.

I have already laid out "The Pattern" of cities and now am prepared to "Let The Wheel Weave" us together.

Us nerdy grown-ups deserve some play time, don't we?

Let me know you are interested and we can exchange information to become Discord, Xbox, Wiki, Twitter, and Facebook friendly. We can discuss how to move forward, share ideas (we doin' this in creative ... or ... "<big>OOO</big>ooo<small>ooo</small>" survival mode for instance), combine skill-sets, do some EPIC research/reading/discussing, build, then most importantly - role-play!

Wha-do-ya say... Are you with me?

Thanks for reading xoxo

Yours truly,
